Game Overview

At its heart, Switch Off is a puzzle game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Switch Off doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Switch Off?

Switch Off is a free puzzle game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Switch Off free to play?

Yes, Switch Off is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
